## Honesty checklist

- [ ] I stated what I did **not** verify, not just what I did.
- [ ] Negative results are classified (environment / search limitation, evidence of absence, observed absence).
- [ ] No proprietary game content is included; quotations are minimal.
- [ ] Any external code or facts are recorded in `docs/research/ecosystem.md`.
